user.title: Cookidoo → Google Keep Sync
user.description: Select source and target lists and optionally a conversation agent (e.g. Claude) for bulk classification of unknown items. The integration will automatically create a todo list 'Cookidoo Keep Categories' whose order defines the supermarket sort order.

abort.already_configured: This source/target combination is already configured.

entities.title: Lists & agent
entities.description: Leave 'Categories list (override)' empty to use the auto-created 'Cookidoo Keep Categories' list.

keywords.title: Keyword → category
keywords.description: Format per line: 'keyword = Category name'. Keywords match case-insensitively as substrings of the item name (longest match wins). Lines starting with '#' are ignored.

learned.title: Learned mappings
learned.description: LLM-learned (or manually maintained) item→category mappings. One per line: 'item-name = Category name'. Manual entries override the LLM since the cache is checked before any classifier runs. Currently: {count} entries.

data.clear_before_sync: Clear the Keep list before each sync

sync.name: Sync Cookidoo → Keep
sync.description: Sync the Cookidoo shopping list to the Google Keep list.
